description: WRITE … BEFORE AFTER ADVANCING … (ISO §2023:14.9.51.2 Format 1; Annex §2023:E.3.3 item 2) — specifying BOTH WORDS on one WRITE is a COBOL-2023 addition. The printed format's choice indicators enclose only BEFORE and AFTER; ADVANCING and its operand sit outside them, ONCE, so there is one advance (§2023:14.9.51.4 GR25 a)) and the words only place it (GR25 e)/f) — the pair presents the record and then advances, exactly as BEFORE alone does). PAGE forbidden with the pair (SR17, COBOL1910). A single BEFORE or AFTER is edition-invariant. Recognition gate on the co-occurrence of the two WORDS.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.51.2 Format 1 / §2023:14.9.51.4 GR25e-f; Annex E.3.3 item 2 (SR17 forbids PAGE with the pair)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. WBA.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRTF ASSIGN TO "vmwba.prt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRTF.
01 P-REC PIC X(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRTF.
    MOVE "AAA" TO P-REC.
    WRITE P-REC BEFORE AFTER ADVANCING 2 LINES.
    CLOSE PRTF.
    STOP RUN.
